pro_course_detail.title: Time To Learn - Kids Lessons 🏆
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed to help your child learn new vocabulary words, form sentences using correct sentence structures, and to practice their reading skills. The lessons follow a structured lesson plan in which your child will be able to progress verbally and grammatically in the English language.

Though these lessons are structured your child will go through the materials at his/her own pace. There is no rush to finish lesson materials in an allocated time but rather your child will move into the next subject and grammar point when he/she has fully grasped the concept. Learning any language is like building a house. You need to have a solid foundation in order to build a strong house. 

Objectives (level dependant):
1. Ask and respond to simple, routine and predictable questions about personal information.
2. Communicate in informal conversations.
3. Understand keywords, some phrases, commands, and sentences in specific conversational topics. 
4. Read a text and discuss it.
5. Write sentences and phrases about the topic being discussed.

Lesson breakdown:
1. Introduction 
2. vocabulary 
3. Controlled practice (match the words, fill in the missing word and sentence reordering)
4. Less controlled practice (conversation)
5. Homework is given at the end of the lesson

pro_course_detail.title: Structured/Textbook Based - Adult Lessons 💻
pro_course_detail.description:
These classes are created to push you out of your comfort zone. We are all happy and comfortable talking about the topics we know and are used to. But, what happens when you are faced with the challenge to speak about something completely different! Your English vocabulary expands and you are able to learn new phrases and eventually talk about absolutely anything!
 
These lessons differ from conversational lessons as they are based on structured materials. There will be a topic for the lesson, a video, a text to read or a specific topic to discuss. 
Instead of a free-flowing conversational lesson, these lessons are guided by the topic discussed for the lesson and the vocabulary words provided.

pro_course_detail.title: Travel Talk 🌎
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you planning to travel abroad but worried that you will not have the correct terms or vocabulary to express yourself clearly in those high-stress situations at the airports? 
We have all been there. Standing at the check-in desk not sure how to ask ''When can I check-in?'' or ''Where can I find the departure time for my flight?'' or even ''Where is the airport bathroom?''. Yes, as a fellow traveller I know the difficulties of trying to communicate while travelling and I know how frustrating it can be.
In my travel talk classes, we will discuss vocabulary words and phrases, read dialogues and do applicable activities that will help you to express what you need and to feel comfortable doing so.
These lessons are for upper beginner - advanced students who are looking to brush up on their English travel vocabulary for their next trip.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is all about creating a comfortable and welcoming space where students feel free to express themselves and engage in meaningful conversations. I believe that the best way to improve your English skills is through practice and immersion in the language, which is why I mainly focus on speaking and listening.

Of course, I am willing to assist with grammar, articulation, and other aspects of English learning if that is something my students wish to focus on. I am very flexible and open to catering to my student's needs, so whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, we can work together to tailor each lesson to your specific learning goals.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to my trial lesson!

 I'm really excited to get to know you and help you improve your English skills. During our lesson, you can expect an unfiltered conversation where we can both share our thoughts and ideas without any barriers. I want you to feel comfortable and free to express yourself.

I like to keep things interesting, so be prepared for some cultural shocks and different thinking along the way. This will help us both spice up our existence and learn more about each other's cultures. If at any point you have questions or want to practice a particular aspect of English, just let me know and we'll work on it together.

Remember, my goal is to create an environment where you can truly be yourself and have fun while learning. So, feel free to book a lesson with me if you're looking for a teacher who enjoys unfiltered conversations and likes to mix things up.

I hope you enjoy our trial lesson and look forward to chatting with you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: OPEN CONVERSATION LESSON
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello everyone! 

Are you looking to improve your English conversation skills in a relaxed and friendly environment? Then this Open Conversation lesson is perfect for you!

As a Community Tutor, I open my lessons to everyone from all walks of life. We will discuss your personal interests, culture, lifestyle, and anything else you'd like to share about your life. I believe that language learning should be fun and engaging, so I cater my lessons to both light and heavy conversations to make sure you get the most out of our time together.

During the lesson, we'll practice English conversation skills, including listening, speaking, and pronunciation. I'll provide feedback and correction when needed so you can improve your communication skills in real-life situations.

This lesson is suitable for all levels, whether you're a beginner or an advanced English speaker. It's a great opportunity for you to get to know me and for me to get to know you too! Let's have fun while improving our English skills together.

Are you ready to start the conversation? Book now and let's get to know each other while conversing in English!

I look forward to chatting with you soon😊

pro_course_detail.title: KIDS CLASS
pro_course_detail.description:
Phonics, Games, Conversation, and Music Class

Get ready for an exciting adventure in learning as I dive into the world of phonics, games, conversation, and music! In my lively and energetic classes, I combine the power of play with the magic of music to create a truly unforgettable learning experience for kids.

With a focus on phonics, I'll unlock the secrets of sounds and letters, helping your little ones master the building blocks of reading and writing. Through engaging games and interactive activities, I'll make phonics come alive, turning learning into a thrilling quest!

But that's not all - my classes are not just about phonics. I believe in the power of conversation and communication, which is why I encourage young learners to express themselves confidently. With fun conversation starters and role-playing exercises, I create an environment where kids can develop their language skills naturally and with enthusiasm.

And let's not forget about the magic of music! My classes are infused with catchy tunes, toe-tapping rhythms, and sing-along sessions that will have your kids grooving and learning at the same time. From alphabet songs to catchy rhymes, I use music as a powerful tool to enhance memory and boost language development.

So, if you're looking for a class that's not only educational but also fun and full of energy, look no further! Join me on this exciting journey where phonics, games, conversation, and music come together to create a dynamic and engaging learning experience for your kids. Get ready to unlock their potential and watch them soar with confidence!
